metadata.question: Was nightime brightness around the Aswan High Dam higher than the Grand Ethopian Renaissance Dam in 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VNP46A2) for 2016 to compare brightness around two dams. 2. Masking: VIIRS data already has quality flags, I'll use the 'NearNadir_Composite_Snow_Free' band which is pre-processed. 3. Logic: Calculate mean nighttime brightness in buffer zones around both dams and compare. For geometries: - Aswan High Dam: Egypt (approx 32.88, 23.97) - Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam: Ethiopia (approx 35.09, 11.21) I'll create 10km buffers around each dam location and calculate mean brightness values. Need to check: - Collection size for both locations - Valid pixel counts - Compare mean brightness values - Handle any data issues ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const aswanDam = ee.Geometry.Point([32.88, 23.97]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer const ethiopiaDam = ee.Geometry.Point([35.09, 11.21]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer const startDate = '2016-01-01'; const endDate = '2016-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Nighttime Lights const viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('avg_rad'); // Check collection size const colSize = viirsCol.size().getInfo(); if (colSize === 0) { print("No VIIRS nighttime data found for 2016."); print("C1"); return; } // Create composite for the year const composite = viirsCol.mean(); // 3. Processing - Calculate mean brightness for both locations const aswanStats = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: aswanDam, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ethiopiaStats = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: ethiopiaDam, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const aswanMean = aswanStats.get('avg_rad_mean').getInfo(); const aswanCount = aswanStats.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); const ethiopiaMean = ethiopiaStats.get('avg_rad_mean').getInfo(); const ethiopiaCount = ethiopiaStats.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); // 4. Check for valid pixels if (aswanCount === 0 || ethiopiaCount === 0) { print(`Aswan pixels: ${aswanCount}, Ethiopia pixels: ${ethiopiaCount}`); print("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer print(`Aswan brightness: ${aswanMean?.toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${aswanCount}`); print(`Ethiopia brightness: ${ethiopiaMean?.toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${ethiopiaCount}`); if (aswanMean === null || ethiopiaMean === null || isNaN(aswanMean) || isNaN(ethiopiaMean)) { print("C3"); } else if (aswanMean > ethiopiaMean) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
